p0182.s: Kinosaki Onsen (seven public bathhouses in one walkable town, since 720 CE); ryokan with private spring baths (onsen)

p0050.s: Arenal Volcano hot springs around La Fortuna, several separate properties, river-fed thermal pools (geothermal spa)

p0014.s: Terra Nostra Park iron-rich thermal pool in Furnas, since 1780 (geothermal spa); volcanic steam vents used for the Cozido das Furnas stew

p0061.s: Termas de Papallacta, about 90 minutes from Quito at 10,660 ft (geothermal spa and natural pools)

p0044.s: Termas Geométricas near Pucón, 17 slate-lined pools fed by more than 60 natural springs (natural outdoor pools)

p0032.s: Széchenyi (one of Europe's largest bath complexes, outdoor pools open through winter since 1963); Rudás and Király, Ottoman-era baths from the 1500s (geothermal spa)

p0122.s: Rotorua's Polynesian Spa, including the Priest's Bath (since the 1870s-80s) (geothermal spa); natural geothermal creeks nearby

p0083.s: Blue Lagoon and other geothermal lagoons (geothermal spa); the Secret Lagoon and river pools such as Reykjadalur (natural outdoor pools)

p0177.s: Beitou, reachable by MRT from Taipei; Jiaoxi's outdoor springs in Yilan (onsen style)

p0018.s: Banff Upper Hot Springs on Sulphur Mountain, the highest hot spring in Canada, 100-104 F year-round, whose 1883 discovery led to the first national park

p0185.s: Saturnia's free natural sulphur pools, Cascate del Mulino, a constant 99 F year-round (natural pools); the Terme di Saturnia resort (geothermal spa)

p0080.s: Rotenburo outdoor baths steaming in real snow; Noboribetsu's large onsen town (onsen and geothermal spa)

p0179.s: Abanotubani's domed brick bathhouses over natural sulfur springs, a founding legend dating to the 5th century (indoor baths, open year-round)

p0012.s: Termas de Puritama, eight geothermal pools in a canyon outside San Pedro de Atacama, long sacred to the Atacameño people (natural pools)

p0010.s: Penny Hot Springs, a roadside soak on the Crystal River about 45 minutes away; Conundrum Hot Springs, an 8.5-mile backcountry hike needing an overnight permit (natural pools)

p0197.s: Chico Hot Springs, a working resort 30-40 minutes outside the park's north entrance in Montana (geothermal spa); the Boiling River inside the park has been closed since the 2022 floods

p0199.s: Leukerbad, the largest thermal resort in the Alps, used since Roman times; outdoor pools ringed by snow-capped peaks (geothermal spa)

p0148.s: Onsen Hot Pools on the Shotover (heated, treated water, not a natural spring); the nearest natural hot spring is Hanmer Springs, about four hours away

p0053.s: Aguas Calientes at the base of Machu Picchu; Cocalmayo on the Salkantay route; La Calera in Colca Canyon, fed by the Cotallaulli volcano (a stopover, not a reason to plan a trip)

p0008.s: Termas de Copahue near the Chilean border, recognized by the WHO for its sulphuric mud and thermal treatments; the access road is closed by snow from about May to November

p0057.s: Terme Dolomia in Val di Fassa, Trentino's only sulphur spring (first documented 1493); Bagni Vecchi di Bormio, a 1,000-year-old pool built into a Roman tunnel

p0090.s: Altyn Arashan ('Golden Spa') near Karakol, rich in radon and hydrogen sulfide, nearly every guesthouse with its own pool; reachable only June to September

p0038.s: Les Thermes de Saint-Gervais, natural spring water at about 102 F, bathing there since at least the 14th century (Chamonix's own spa uses heated water, not a spring)

p0159.s: Termas de Polques beside Laguna Salada near the Salvador Dali Desert geysers, over 14,110 ft, a fixed stop on the multi-day 4x4 tours (natural pools)

p0140.s: Ma'in Hot Springs between Madaba and the Dead Sea, a waterfall cascading into natural thermal pools Herod the Great reportedly used; summers top 104 F

p0156.s: Hot Sulphur Springs Resort, about 30 minutes from the park's west entrance near Grand Lake (there is no hot spring inside the park)

p0077.s: Uunartoq's hot spring on an uninhabited island in South Greenland, used since Norse settlers about 1,000 years ago; reachable only by organized boat tour June to September (natural pool)
